production.common.intro: Mix tracks, edit clips and open advanced settings on this page.
production.common.timelineNamed: Tracks, tempo and markers on the shared ruler
production.tempo.addNamed: Add tempo at the playback position
export.button.disabledNoAudio: Import or generate audio before exporting.
export.button.disabledBusy: Export or another task is in progress.
clips.stretch.title: Tempo / pitch
phase3.routing.sendsHint: Adjustable amount to an aux return. Pre-fader = before the track fader; post-fader = after.
phase3.routing.needAux: Create an aux bus first for sends.
phase3.mix.sidechainHint: Source → destination with threshold and ratio. Source and destination must differ.
phase3.mix.sidechainSameTrack: Source and destination must be different tracks.
phase3.mix.sidechainMissingTrack: Source or destination track not found in the mix.
phase3.mix.sidechainNeedTracks: At least two tracks are required for sidechain.
phase3.mix.loudnessNote: Measured on the rendered mix (clips + production). Measurement only — no automatic normalization.
phase3.mix.loudnessNeedStems: Stems required to measure the rendered mix.
clips.tempoHint: Tempo changes do not alter source files or clip offsets; playback and export remain in milliseconds.
clips.markerShiftClips: Move clips with the marker (without changing the source)
production.edit.title: Clip editing
production.edit.select.hint: V: select and move. Edges trim the clip; the fields below accept values in ms.
production.edit.cut.hint: C: click to split. X splits at the playback position inside the clip, or its midpoint otherwise.
production.edit.fade.hint: F: drag in the left or right half to adjust the fade. Fade fields also accept values in ms.
production.edit.marker.hint: M: click the Markers lane or a clip to place a marker.
production.select.needClip: Select a clip to move it.
production.cut.needClip: Select a clip to split it.
production.cut.midpoint: Playback position outside the clip: splitting at midpoint.
production.fade.needClip: Select a clip to adjust fades.
production.playhead.back: Move playback position one step back
production.playhead.forward: Move playback position one step forward
mix.importHint: WAV, MP3, or FLAC — copied into the project, normalized to 48 kHz stereo PCM. Does not alter AI stems.
production.fade.error.tooLong: Fade in and fade out together are longer than the clip duration.
production.fade.error.negative: Fade length must be zero or positive.
phase3.mix.vocalFx.vocalsOnly: Voice cleanup, pitch correction, and voice conversion can only be added on a vocal track. Disable the effect to return to the original (A/B).
phase3.mix.pitchCorrect.vocalsOnly: Pitch correction can only be added on a vocal track. Disable the effect to return to the original (A/B).
phase3.mix.pitchCorrect.honesty: Light local correction (not commercial Autotune). Playback and export share the same bake. Settings are kept with the mix production overlay. See also #164 (voice effects).
phase3.mix.voiceCleanup.honesty: Classical spectral denoise (no neural net). Too much strength can hurt consonants — raise preserve attack. Non-destructive insert; same bake for playback / export (#164).
phase3.mix.voiceConvert.consent: I confirm the voice model is my own (user's voice only)
phase3.mix.voiceConvert.loicConstraint: Loïc constraint: conversion limited to the user's own voice, with consent. No third-party or artist voices.
phase3.mix.voiceConvert.needsConsent: Conversion refused until consent is checked. No third-party model is bundled.
phase3.mix.voiceConvert.notShipped: Consent recorded — the conversion model is not shipped yet (UI scaffolding only, #164).
phase3.mix.param.eqBandsHint: Bands with curve type, frequency, gain, and Q — separate from the shelf EQ.
phase3.mix.param.delayHint: Without a valid tempo, delay uses free time in ms. Feedback is capped to avoid runaway feedback.

production.separate.disabledBusy: Operation in progress — try again in a moment.

production.fx.noneSelected: Select an effect to edit its properties.
production.track.clipNone: No clip selected on this track.

production.track.auto.hint: The automation curve appears under the track when the option is on.
production.auto.locked: Unlock the track to edit its automation curve.
production.auto.empty: No points: the track setting remains active.
qwen.mix.modelMissing: The configured model is missing. Install it on the local LLM server and try again.
qwen.mix.needStems: Decoded audio tracks are required to measure their levels.
qwen.mix.stale: The mix changed after this analysis. Analyse again before confirming.
qwen.mix.serviceMissing: Start the local LLM server on this computer and try again.
qwen.mix.remoteBlocked: Remote servers are disabled. Enable expert cloud mode, or use a local address.
qwen.mix.invalid: The model returned invalid settings. No settings were applied.
qwen.mix.totalMeasured: Complete analysis, including track decoding: {time} s.
qwen.mix.failed: The local model could not finish this analysis. Check the LLM server and try again.
qwen.mix.confirm: Confirm these gain and pan changes?
qwen.mix.rationale: Settings proposed from measured track levels.
qwen.mix.local: The assistant analyses measured track levels on this computer. Audio and summaries stay on this computer unless expert cloud mode is enabled. The model must be available on the configured LLM server.
qwen.mix.licenseNotice: Apache-2.0 · Copyright 2026 Alibaba Cloud. The weights are installed separately on the local LLM server. The license text is available here, offline.
qwen.mix.title: Local mix assistant
qwen.mix.allowRemote: Expert mode: allow a remote (cloud) server
qwen.mix.allowRemoteWarn: Track summaries will leave this computer. Off by default.
qwen.mix.serverSaveFailed: Could not save the LLM server.

midi.output.title: MIDI output
midi.output.hint: Send the selected score voice to a synthesizer or virtual MIDI port. Channel and program numbers start at 1.
midi.output.osLimit: Native proofs: Windows GS Wavetable only. macOS (CoreMIDI) and Linux (ALSA) are compiled, not hardware-tested in this repo. Windows USB: unverified.
midi.output.error: The MIDI output is unavailable. Find outputs and reconnect the port.
midi.output.empty: Find outputs after connecting your synthesizer or virtual port.
clips.hint: Drag a clip to move it, its edges to trim it, and its handles to adjust fades. Alt+click to split. Use arrow keys to nudge. Musical or time grid.
